Attached: 1 video

Google just bought 40 years of Spirit Airlines' internal data for $10M to train AI. Customer records were excluded — but 175,000 employee files were not. A flight attendants union is now fighting it. Sept 9 decides if bankrupt data becomes AI fuel. Thoughts? ✈️🤖
